# p2pchat v0.3.0

The first private release of the local-first, end-to-end encrypted terminal
chat client.

## Install

```sh
gh release download v0.3.0 \
  --repo AshrithSathu/p2pchat \
  --pattern 'p2p-chat-0.3.0.tgz'
corepack pnpm add --global \
  --allow-build=better-sqlite3 \
  --allow-build=@signalapp/libsignal-client \
  ./p2p-chat-0.3.0.tgz
p2pchat
```

Requires Node.js 22 or newer and Corepack. The package installs native libsignal
and SQLite builds for the current supported platform.

## Security

- PQXDH plus Double Ratchet inside the already authenticated transport.
- Exact-pinned official libsignal TypeScript package.
- Encrypted local identities, ratchet state, and message bodies.
- Live production relay at `p2pchat-relay.sathuashrith.com`.

This release has not received an independent security audit. Read
`SECURITY.md` and compare safety numbers before sharing sensitive information.
